title: Mặt trăng xanh
about: Round x16 (album 11), the user: "hãy sáng tác album 11", after album 10 (electronic sleep) was kept whole: more electronic sleep ambient (style ngu-dt), slow (48 bpm), pad, air, shimmer, sub, swells, an improvised keys tune with a long echo. No drums. Remade before release on a less common progression of its own (the user, after Content ID matches on plain i-VI-iv-V pieces: "ok làm lại album 11 an toàn hơn"). An original piece.
